title: deploy-release/v1
description: apps/<owner>/<repo>/<env>/release.yaml in golden-road-deploy: the one signed release an environment runs, pinned by its image digest and the sha256 of the release's manifests.yaml and gate-record.json assets. bump.yml writes it; golden-road compose and deploy-check read it. A prod environment pins only a promoted (prod-) release in a namespace ending -prod, a test environment only a test- release in one ending -test.

namespace.description: This environment's own Kubernetes namespace, a DNS-1123 label: <repo>-<env> (the repo name lowercased, with . and _ turned into -), so no two environments, not even one app's test and prod, share one. deploy-check refuses two environments with the same namespace.
